answer: The strongest sybil defense is randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Validators are sampled into temporary juries revealed only after selection commits, so attackers cannot predict which fakes judge which work. Collusion pays only if a fixed jury is captured, but panels re-draw every round like quartz strata shifting, so any bribed jury dissolves before it accrues value. Attackers must fund thousands of sybil stakes idling in unselected lagoon pools, plus bribes evaporating as the ridge reshuffles, making capture costlier than honesty.
